population: B2B clean-train folds 0-3, exactly 1421 queries; fold4=611, B2B581, internal300, development and confirmation sealed
criterion: For each defined anchor, stable success is three consecutive add-only prefixes above the canonical threshold. Earliest stable stop is the first prefix of the first qualifying run; the run is future-informed oracle evidence, not an online stopping rule.
ordered_stops: All anchors use the same scalar fidelity and are nested, so earliest stable start and completion indices are automatically nondecreasing with threshold on any fixed chain.
joint_coverage: Exactly equal to stable success at the highest attainable anchor: 0.90 for four-anchor queries, 0.95 for five-anchor queries.
pool: Evaluate V8 plus ten V13 projected orders separately; report existence of one order satisfying the full vector and Pareto-safe improvements over V8. Do not combine per-anchor best metrics from different orders.
full_lattice: Use exact subset-DAG run DP for joint coverage, and for newly joint-stable queries construct an exact minimum-Kendall-distance order relative to V8. This certifies reachability and minimum inversion distance, not minimum multi-anchor token cost or deployment learnability.
pareto: A candidate is a safe quality gain if no ordinary or stable anchor success breaks and at least one stable anchor repairs. At matched ordinary and stable vectors, compare per-anchor earliest stable token costs and cumulative stable tokens only when jointly stable.
